about_the_game:
OVERVIEW:

Hexborn is a brutal roguelite boomer shooter where you descend into cursed arenas, wield occult firepower, and build unholy strength through randomized upgrades. Inspired by Blood and Doom, it delivers crunchy retro combat, escalating challenges, and visceral moment-to-moment chaos.


You are Lucian Cross, a mercenary bound to an ancient demon, diving deeper into the Bloodstone Labyrinth to stop the Cult of Shadows from awakening a long-buried god. Every run is a desperate stand against ever-stronger foes — and every kill fuels your unholy evolution.

Built around arena survival and high-intensity FPS combat, Hexborn combines crunchy retro gunplay with modern roguelite progression. Slay increasingly tough enemies, earn XP, level up mid-fight, and unlock unique builds every run. Every fight is a test of reflex, aggression, and build mastery.

💀 Wishlist now and be the first to join the adventure into the Bloodstone Labyrinth!!!

KEY FEATURES:

  • 🩸 Crunchy Boomer Shooter Combat
    Dodge, strafe, and blast through waves of cultists and monsters in fast-paced, retro-inspired FPS arenas.

  • 💀 Occult Arsenal
    Wield devastating tools like Laucia’s triple-barreled shotgun, the Necronomicon spellbook, and the napalm launcher — all designed to feel brutal, distinct, and memorable.

  • 🔮 Random Perk Drafts = Unique Builds
    Every kill fuels your rise. Level up in combat and shape your build one perk at a time.

  • 👺 Wave-Based Arena Progression
    Battle through escalating enemy waves across intense combat arenas filled with dynamic spawns and tactical pressure.

Prepare to descend into the darkness, where every choice could be your last.

name: Hexborn

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 380 (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super or AMD Radeon RX 590 (DirectX 12 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card with latest drivers

short_description: A fast-paced roguelite boomer shooter inspired by 90s classics like Blood and Doom. Wield brutal firepower and occult tools to battle cultists and eldritch horrors, choose powerful perks, and survive escalating horde arenas.
